title: The Postcards of Milton Flats
author: Mirabel Iversen
blurb: Mirabel Vasquez, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
